function read<T extends string[]>(values: [...T]) {
  for (const value of values) value.toFixed();
}
function destructure<T extends string[]>(values: readonly [...T]) {
  const [value] = values;
  return value.toFixed();
}
function index<T extends string[]>(values: [...T]) {
  return values[0].toFixed();
}
function call<T extends string[]>(values: [...T]) {
  const accept = (value: number) => value;
  accept(values[0]);
}
